description: Source code for the jjwg_Maps module class, a customization extension for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM that handles geocoding, map marker management, and related address functionalities. Contains class definitions, configuration methods, geocoding API integration, and address handling logic.

classes.name: jjwg_Maps
classes.description: A class extending jjwg_Maps_sugar that manages geocoding, address formatting, configuration, and map marker functionalities within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: configuration
methods.description: Loads configuration settings from the Administration module and applies defaults.

methods.name: saveConfiguration
methods.description: Saves configuration settings to the Administration module based on provided data.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode information for a given bean, typically during save operations.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for meetings related to another bean (e.g., Account, Contact).

methods.name: updateMeetingGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for a specific Meeting bean after save.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfoByAssocQuery
methods.description: Updates or inserts geocode info in a custom table based on record association.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfoByBeanQuery
methods.description: Executes update or insert queries to manage geocode info for a Bean.

methods.name: deleteAllGeocodeInfoByBeanQuery
methods.description: Removes all geocode info from the custom table for the Bean's module.

methods.name: getGeocodeAddressesResult
methods.description: Retrieves records needing geocoding within a specified limit.

methods.name: getGoogleMapsGeocode
methods.description: Performs geocoding via Google Maps API to obtain latitude and longitude for an address.

methods.name: defineMapsAddress
methods.description: Determines the full address for different module types and related entities.

methods.name: defineMapsFormattedAddress
methods.description: Constructs a formatted address string from address fields based on the specified type.

methods.name: is_valid_lng
methods.description: Validates if a longitude value is within -180 to 180 degrees.

methods.name: is_valid_lat
methods.description: Validates if a latitude value is within -90 to 90 degrees.

methods.name: logGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Logs detailed geocode data for a bean object in a readable format.
